senses.zh_definition: 拉撒路：男子名字；在基督教经文中，可指《约翰福音》里的伯大尼人拉撒路，或《路加福音》富人与穷人比喻中的拉撒路，须按上下文区分。
senses.en_definition: A masculine personal name, borne by Lazarus of Bethany in John and by the poor man in a parable in Luke.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas lelaki; dalam Bible, nama ini merujuk antaranya kepada Lazarus dari Betania atau orang miskin dalam perumpamaan tentang orang kaya dan Lazarus.
senses.nuances: 本项按专有名词释名，pos 的 noun 对应 kata nama khas。输入没有 DBP 释义，因此这里的马来文说明不是 DBP 官方引文；status 按要求保留 official，不构成 DBP 收录证明。两处经文人物应分别处理，不能仅凭同名认定为同一人。搭配为常见人名句式，未声称具有经语料验证的高频排名。经文依据：[John 11](https://classic.biblegateway.com/passage/?search=John+11&version=NIV)、[Luke 16 discussion](https://www.vatican.va/content/benedict-xvi/en/angelus/2007/documents/hf_ben-xvi_ang_20070930.html)。

etymology.historical_story: Lazarus belongs to the biblical naming tradition and is a shortened form of Eleazar, associated with the meaning God helps. Christian texts give the name two distinct narrative settings: the man raised by Jesus in John and the poor man in Luke's parable. These associations explain its religious resonance, but a modern bearer need not be identified with either biblical figure. [Vatican explanation](https://www.vatican.va/content/benedict-xvi/en/angelus/2007/documents/hf_ben-xvi_ang_20070930.html); [John 11](https://classic.biblegateway.com/passage/?search=John+11&version=NIV)
